headline: Ballari district, part of Hyderabad-Karnataka region, experiences high maternal anaemia rates. Women describe infant deaths using the word 'khaali,' reflecting malnutrition's impac
summary: Ballari faces severe child undernutrition, with a 2018 study finding 40.6% of 1-5 year children undernourished in urban areas, including 18.6% severely affected. By 2021, the district identified 827 severely and 45,774 moderately malnourished children. Stunting prevalence reached 43.2% and wasting 23.9%. The government responded with nutrition intervention programmes for children with Severe Acute Malnutrition, including residential treatment at nutrition rehabilitation centers. District authorities added boiled eggs to midday meals in Ballari as part of an eight-district initiative to address acute malnutrition, though programme implementation faced challenges including anganwadi closures during Covid-19.

reasons.detail: Ballari district, part of Hyderabad-Karnataka region, experiences high maternal anaemia rates. Women describe infant deaths using the word 'khaali,' reflecting malnutrition's impact on pregnancy outcomes.

Ballari flagged as one of 10 districts with major poverty challenges. The Karnataka Human Development Report 2022 recommends agricultural interventions to increase farm productivity and lift populations from poverty.

Midday meals stopped after lockdown, with ration kits inadequately distributed. Data shows 9,544 malnourished children between April-October 2020. Pregnant woman in Hampasagara struggled to get rations under Chief Minister's scheme.
One pregnant woman lacked nutritious meal provision during first pregnancy three years prior, highlighting service inconsistency in reaching all beneficiaries.
